title: nothing like the picture
text: nothing like the picture. I cannot imagine anyone paying the supposed retail price; it's a cheap looking rag not worth returning. I wouldn't put that cheap looking wrinkled rag in my bedroom and it's not worth returning. Also the lining is a rough fabric the kind you see in like a Barbie toy house LOL. Will donate to charity.
